'''Redfish''' were native to the vacation [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Amfar/Legends|Amfar]]. They were unusual, in that they congregated out of the [[Water/Legends|water]], normally on the [[Beach/Legends|beaches]], during certain [[Time/Legends|times]] of day. Because of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], there was a steep drop in the number of tourists who would usually scare the creatures. Because of this, the redfish began to reclaim the now-deserted beaches.<ref name="HNN52" />
